`final class ResourceFormat`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.format` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ResourceFormat.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/format/ResourceFormat.java)

The registry of the resource formats, which picks the decoder of a file from its first bytes.

## Description

The built-in formats read the files of [Supported formats](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/media/#supported-formats); a file that none of them recognizes goes to the bundled image readers.
The last registered format is asked first.

<a id="ResourceFormat-method-register"></a>

### register

`void register(IResourceFormat format)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Adds a format in front of the others; registering it again moves it to the front.

<a id="ResourceFormat-method-unregister"></a>

### unregister

`void unregister(IResourceFormat format)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Removes a format, a built-in one included.

<a id="ResourceFormat-method-decoder"></a>

### decoder

`IResourceDecoder decoder(Asset asset)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Reads the first 4096 bytes of `asset` and returns the decoder of the first format that supports them, otherwise a [`RasterResourceDecoder`](/reference/resources/rasterresourcedecoder/).
Throws `UncheckedIOException` when the asset cannot be read.
